name: When should I call a professional for an underground water leak?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for an underground water leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional plumber as soon as you suspect an underground water leak. Early detection and repair can prevent significant damage to your home's foundation, landscaping, and other underground utilities. Ignoring a leak can lead to mold growth, structural issues, and substantially higher water bills. Alpha-Plumbing Services offers prompt service in Goodyear, Buckeye, Avondale, and Surprise to address these urgent issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional immediately if you suspect an underground water leak to prevent severe damage and higher costs.
